svg.aria-label: Left: four boxes of damage, each with an arrow to its repair pathway. Right: four steps of nucleotide excision repair on a twelve-base sequence: a thymine dimer joins two adjacent Ts, a section containing it is cut out, the gap is refilled using the opposite strand as the template, and ligase seals the strand with the original sequence restored.

g.title: replication error missed by proofreading: Damage to DNA.
base excision repair: removes single damaged bases
thymine dimer (UV light): Damage to DNA.
nucleotide excision repair: removes bulky damage
homologous recombination: sister chromatid as the template
non-homologous end joining: can lose bases
